name: mirage
text:
Three answers.
1) The 400 cap: Volume mode had a hard-coded 400 that ignored your Unlimited setting (I'd set it that way on 11-02 to slow the churn). I changed it so Unlimited is honored; bids per pass stay capped at 125 so Novig's reads aren't starved. It's in the code and tested, but not released yet, so the engine still caps at 400 until the next version ships.
2) PinnAPI key: I can't write GitHub secrets from here. The app sends keys itself. Paste it in Settings > APIs > PinnAPI, switch it on, then Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys to GitHub. I haven't stored the key anywhere.
3) Odds API keys all showing equal usage: the Odds API itself reports the same 64 used / 436 left on all 23 keys. They look like one shared quota, so extra keys add no credits. The app does stick to one key, but each new runner starts over and the app's own call counts differ per key. If they're really separate accounts, tell me and I'll dig further.
